name: Cinematic Video Underlay with Vector Overlay
visual_intent: Provides atmospheric background motion beneath high-contrast vector charts and text without distracting from pedagogical focus.

parameters.name: stageSelector
parameters.description: Selector for sharp SVG vector stage on top.

parameters.name: fadeInDuration
parameters.description: Fade in duration for video underlay.

timeline_requirements.timing_anchors: Starts at scene introduction (T=0.0s) and loops or spans scene duration.

code_snippet.javascript:
tl.fromTo('#veo-bg', { opacity: 0 }, { opacity: 0.28, duration: fadeInDuration, ease: 'power1.inOut' }, startTime);
tl.from('#vector-stage text', { opacity: 0, y: 20, duration: 0.8, stagger: 0.2 }, startTime + 0.5);

fallbacks: High-resolution static gradient background if external video asset is absent.
validation_steps: Verify video asset has been normalized via scripts/ingest-asset.sh (silent H.264 1280x720 30fps).
Snapshot at startTime + 1.5s to verify vector legibility against atmospheric video background.
